title: The Pans All Say Lou

youtube_title: Everyone's Friendsgiving Dish Had The Same Name On The Pan | Funny Cartoon
description:
Jasmine is hosting Friendsgiving and wants everybody to show what they are bringing. Derek is bringing ice. Again. Then three homemade dishes show up in the same blue pan with the same name on the sticker.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #friendsgiving
tiktok_caption: what i'm bringing to friendsgiving (an honest list) 🦃 #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #friendsgiving

lines.text: Friendsgiving is Saturday. Everybody film what you are bringing and send it to the group.
I am bringing ice.
He has brought ice six years in a row. I am the gravy boat. I remember everything.
Derek. Ice is not a dish. Ice is weather you can hold.
Ice is the backbone of the party. Without ice, your drinks are just warm soup.
I come out once a year. Like a comet with a handle.
Everybody else is taking this seriously. Clip one. Tasha.
Tasha is bringing sweet potato casserole. Tiny marshmallows. Toasted. Golden. Personal.
See? Effort. Clip two. Big Mike.
Big Mike is bringing green bean casserole. He says it is his grandmother's recipe.
Big Mike's grandmother lives in Florida and only makes reservations.
Do not ruin Big Mike for me.
Clip three. Kelsey. Mac and cheese in a blue pan. With a little sticker on the side.
What sticker?
It says Lou. In purple marker. With a little heart.
Huh.
Probably her mom. Moving on. My clip. I am making the turkey. From scratch.
She has never made a turkey. She has made a turkey sandwich. Twice.
I watched a lot of videos. I own a baster now.
You are holding it like a microphone.
Because I am a performer in this kitchen.
Can I update my clip? I am bringing ice. And a cooler for the ice.
That is still ice, Derek.
It is ice with a home now.
Last year he brought one bag of ice and left with three plates of leftovers. Business genius.
This year, everybody brings something real. Derek. Bring rolls.
Rolls are a commitment. Rolls can go wrong.
You buy them. In a bag.
And if the bag tears? Rolls everywhere. On the floor. Rolling.
He is not wrong. That is why they are called rolls.
Okay. It is Saturday. Food is arriving. Tasha's casserole. Big Mike's beans. Kelsey's mac.
Jasmine. Look at the pans.
What about the pans?
Blue pan. Blue pan. Blue pan. Every pan says Lou.
Three pans. Three stickers. Three little hearts.
Maybe Lou is a pan company.
A pan company that writes in purple marker?
Let us not panic. My turkey is in the oven. My turkey is mine.
Her turkey has been in the oven eleven minutes. It needs four hours.
The video said one hour!
The video was a chicken.
Derek. What do we do?
Stay calm. I know a guy. Well. I know a lady.
Somebody need Lou?
Everybody. This is my Grandma Lou.
Hello, babies. Tasha's casserole. Big Mike's beans. Kelsey's mac. All mine. Pick up was Thursday.
You made everybody's dish?
I run a little Friendsgiving business out of my kitchen. Twelve orders this week.
I told them about her six years ago. I never bring food. I bring ice, because I bring the cook.
The ice was a cover story. I knew it. I hold gravy and secrets.
So I am the only one who actually cooked?
Let Grandma see the turkey, baby.
Oh. Oh, sweetheart. It is still wearing the plastic.
I thought that was part of it. Like a little jacket.
She owns a baster.
Move. Grandma is here. Derek, ice. Gravy boat, warm up.
Finally. Somebody who respects the boat.
Wait. Big Mike said it was his grandmother's recipe.
It is. On Thursdays I am everybody's grandmother.
That is why the leftovers are so good.
Fine. Next year we do not film what we are bringing. We film who made it.
Then I want my name at the end. In purple. With a heart.
And what is Derek bringing next year?
Ice.
Twelve dollars a plate, baby. Ice is free.
